title: Higher education law provides funding boost to Fostering Independence Grants, fighting fraud
supports: The 2026 higher-education law appropriated $3 million to the Minnesota State system to implement an identity-verification system to combat ghost-student financial-aid fraud.
The appropriation took effect July 1, 2026; most policy provisions took effect August 1, 2026 unless otherwise indicated.
does_not_support: The appropriation does not establish a statewide fraud-loss amount.
The legislative summary does not prove that every flagged application is fraudulent or that aid was disbursed.
